definitions.explanation: An official or formal action taken to deal with a situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧な{措置|そち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{措置|そち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧{措置|そち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{講|こう}じる→講じる：27841_koujiru⟧。

notes:
{措置|そち} means measures, steps, or actions—typically official or formal responses to situations.

REGISTER:
Formal word used in administrative, legal, and business contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {措置|そち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take measures
- {措置|そち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{講|こう}じる→講じる：27841_koujiru⟧: to implement/adopt measures
- ⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧な{措置|そち}: appropriate measures
- ⟦{応急|おうきゅう}→応急：08193_oukyuu⟧{措置|そち}: emergency/first-aid measures
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{措置|そち}: urgent measures
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧{措置|そち}: safety measures
- ⟦{暫定|ざんてい}→暫定：05626_zantei⟧{措置|そち}: provisional measures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: countermeasures, policy
- ⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: response, handling
